what_it_shows: HERO. Thomas Hicks, exhausted, walking on a dirt road flanked by his two attendants (Lucas caption: Hugh C. McGrath and Charles J.P. Same image as Commons "Marathon Hicks1904.jpg" but this is the higher-res, well-provenanced MoHist scan.
best_segments: Sentence 3 (strychnine + brandy reveal): slow push-in on Hicks' face; crop of the attendant holding his arm. Also usable as end-card.

best_segments: Sentence 1 (hook) circle/highlight #31 "this guy rode in a car"; sentence 3 circle #20 Hicks.
